newsitem.title: UK: Tour operator Airtours sees good 97 summer.
newsitem.headline: Tour operator Airtours sees good 97 summer.

text.p: British holiday company Airtours Plc said on Wednesday it was confident about its full-year prospects on the back of improvements in both the UK and Scandinavian markets.

"The group has had a very satisfactory first half year and with booking levels and load factors in our major markets showing appreciable gains over the previous year, we look forward with confidence to the second half of the year," chairman David Crossland said.

The company reported a 45 percent reduction in seasonal first half pre-tax losses to 12.7 million pounds ($20.7 million) as turnover climbed 34 percent to 818.4 million pounds. It increased its interim dividend by 23 percent to 4.0 pence per share.

The seasonal loss from UK tour operations fell by 46 percent to 9.6 million pounds while Scandinavia contributed winter profits of 5.5 million pounds, the first time it has been in the black in that period.
UK tour operations bookings for summer 97 were reported 28.8 percent ahead of last year, compared with an increase of 14.3 percent for the industry as at the end of March.
Airtours said the amount of full priced brochure sales achieved so far meant its UK operation had less stock to sell than at this time last year. ($ = 0.613 British Pounds)
